review_method: Each label, its location and its conditions were read from the Stroom source at the commit verified_against, and each carries the file and line it was read from; a test re-reads every line. Icons are named as the source names them (SvgImage and file), as provenance, not as a description of how they look. Source-reviewed; what a running Stroom showed of each entry is its separate browser evidence.
conditions_basis: Conditions (permissions, selection, document type, when shown or enabled) were reviewed from source; they are not compiler-checked, and no condition was exercised with a user lacking a permission.

browser_check.user: admin (internal identity provider, member of Administrators)
browser_check.method: A throwaway Stroom from the image, with its own MySQL on a private network and throwaway content, opened in headless Chromium with Playwright. Each entry's label was looked for on its screen or dialog: as visible text, or as a title attribute for a tooltip.
browser_check.scope: confirmed means the label (or tooltip) was seen on the named screen in this run. It does not validate its position within the screen, its conditions, its icon, or that the image was built from the source commit verified_against. 'not found in this run' and 'not exercised' are not proof of absence.
